brainlife.desc: Neuroglancer precomputed image or segmentation volume (info JSON plus chunked data), single- or multi-resolution.
brainlife.name: neuro/precomputed/volume

original.desc: This is a Neuroglancer precomputed Volume
original.readme:
The *precomputed* data source format is based on static collections of files served directly over HTTP; it therefore can be used without any special serving infrastructure. In particular, it can be used with data hosted by a cloud storage provider like Google Cloud Storage or Amazon S3. Note that it is necessary, however, to either host the Neuroglancer client from the same server or enable CORS access to the data.

Several types of data are supported:
Single-resolution or multi-resolution image/segmentation volume
Single-resolution or multi-resolution object surface meshes (keyed by uint64 object ids)
Object skeleton representations (keyed by uint64 object ids)
Collection of point/line/bounding box/ellipsoid annotations
Segment property maps
Precomputed data sources are specified using the following data source URL syntax:

precomputed://FILE_URL, where FILE_URL is a URL to the directory containing a precomputed format info metadata file using any supported file protocol.

Here is more information about the Precomputed File Format: https://github.com/google/neuroglancer/tree/master/src/datasource/precomputed

**Use for:** Neuroglancer viewing and mesh generation from segmentations.

**Not for:** Tools expecting NIfTI or OME-Zarr without conversion.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.precomputed.volume.json

identifying_risks: Donor codes may appear in the info metadata.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 2: human status depends on the specimen; participant-level tissue images carry no direct identifiers (Tier 2), non-human data is Tier 1.
sharing_cautions: Confirm species and donor consent terms before sharing human tissue images.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 when the specimen is non-human (e.g. mouse) or synthetic.
Tier 2 for human tissue linked to a donor or specimen code.

intended_use: Neuroglancer viewing and mesh generation from segmentations.
